task: Move fifteen-day Fair Use diagnostic cleanup out of receive/evaluation transactions

composition.services_diff: Only the one field and one constructor assignment; agreed before editing.
composition.scheduler: Existing fair_use cycle every 15 seconds; no new job or task framework. Retention and evaluation errors are joined and independent work continues.

data_responsibility.subscription_flow_start_events: Auxiliary flow.started diagnostics after the authoritative Zero observability path accepts the event; used by Telemetry and ObservationSeries. Not settlement authorization or billing identity.
data_responsibility.subscription_fair_use_events: Derived evaluation explanation events; queried by authorized FairUseObservations.Events. Current evaluation state remains in the separate subscription_fair_use_states table.
data_responsibility.authoritative_facts: TrafficRecord, FlowUsage, node cursors and projection intents remain untouched; no cleanup of publication, business audit, entitlement, order or evaluation-state rows.
data_responsibility.diagnostic_identity_limit: The existing unique(node_id,event_id) identity is retained only while its raw diagnostic row exists. After fifteen-day pruning, a late flow.started replay can be counted diagnostically again. No permanent per-connection identity table was added; financial replay remains unchanged.

bounds.threshold: UTC now minus 15*24 hours; strict less-than; raw uses received_at, evaluation events use occurred_at.
bounds.per_cycle_per_table: At most 1000 candidate IDs, point-locked rows and deleted rows; one independent short READ COMMITTED transaction per table, no drain loop.
bounds.discovery: Unlocked query outside the write transaction, ordered by its time column ASC then id ASC; candidate IDs sorted in Go before primary-key locking.
bounds.cutoff_revalidation: The timestamp is reread under the exact-PK row lock and checked before deletion. DELETE contains primary keys only, not a temporal range.
bounds.raw_index: Existing idx_subscription_flow_start_received(received_at) supports the discovery ordering; SQLite EXPLAIN shows a covering-index range search.
bounds.evaluation_discovery_limitation: Existing indexes lead with subscription_id or event_type, not global occurred_at. SQLite EXPLAIN shows a composite-index SCAN and temporary ORDER BY B-tree. LIMIT bounds candidate output, not scanned/sorted work. No global scan bound or full P4/archive safety claim is made, and no migration was added.
bounds.backlog: Rows older than the threshold can remain until later bounded cycles; the fifteen-day cutoff is preserved, not an immediate full-purge guarantee.
